ex.en: We took a spontaneous trip to the beach.
ex.zh: 我們臨時起意去了海邊。

ex.en: The audience burst into spontaneous applause.
ex.zh: 觀眾自發地熱烈鼓掌。

ex.en: Tom found a wonderful spouse in Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆找到了瑪麗這麼好的另一半。

ex.en: Employees and their spouses are invited to the party.
ex.zh: 員工和配偶都受邀參加派對。

ex.en: Korean food is noted for its spicy flavor.
ex.zh: 韓國菜以辣聞名。

ex.en: Tom doesn't like any kind of spicy food.
ex.zh: 湯姆不喜歡任何辣的食物。

ex.en: I don't mind if it's hot and spicy.
ex.zh: 辣一點沒關係。

ex.en: Let's split the bill today.
ex.zh: 今天我們各付各的吧。

ex.en: Let's split the reward fifty-fifty.
ex.zh: 這筆報酬我們對半分吧。

ex.en: "Didn't you get married!?" "Oh, we split up. We broke our engagement."
ex.zh: 「你們不是結婚了嗎？」「喔，我們分手了，婚約也取消了。」

ex.en: They split up after five years together.
ex.zh: 他們在一起五年後分手了。

ex.en: A sharp crack of thunder split the sky.
ex.zh: 一聲尖銳的雷響劃破了天空。

ex.en: He split the wood with an axe.
ex.zh: 他用斧頭劈柴。

ex.en: He's a specialist in economics.
ex.zh: 他是經濟學專家。

ex.en: Specialists are people who have only one string on their violin.
ex.zh: 專家就像一把只有一根弦的小提琴。

ex.en: My doctor sent me to a heart specialist.
ex.zh: 我的醫生讓我去看心臟專科醫師。

ex.en: Don't read the comments. They're full of spoilers.
ex.zh: 別看留言，裡面全是雷。

ex.en: No spoilers, please! I haven't seen it yet.
ex.zh: 拜託別爆雷！我還沒看。

ex.en: There weren't many spectators at the game because of the rain.
ex.zh: 因為下雨，球場上觀眾不多。

ex.en: Thousands of spectators watched the race.
ex.zh: 上千名觀眾觀看了這場比賽。

ex.en: Spring is here. It is getting warmer every day.
ex.zh: 春天來了，天氣一天比一天暖和。

ex.en: Spring Festival is also known as Chinese New Year.
ex.zh: 春節也就是農曆新年。

ex.en: There are a lot of hot springs in Japan.
ex.zh: 日本有很多溫泉。

ex.en: We went to Beitou to soak in the hot springs.
ex.zh: 我們去北投泡溫泉。

ex.en: The old mattress has broken springs.
ex.zh: 這張舊床墊的彈簧壞了。

ex.en: The toy jumps when you press the spring.
ex.zh: 按一下彈簧，玩具就會跳起來。

ex.en: I won't participate in speculation.
ex.zh: 我不會參與揣測。

ex.en: There is a lot of speculation about who will be the next CEO.
ex.zh: 大家都在猜下一任執行長會是誰。

ex.en: Speculation pushed house prices up quickly.
ex.zh: 投機炒作讓房價迅速上漲。

ex.en: He lost a fortune in land speculation.
ex.zh: 他炒地皮賠了一大筆錢。

ex.en: I don't think this sponsor is very suitable.
ex.zh: 我覺得這家贊助商不太合適。

ex.en: The bank is the main sponsor of the marathon.
ex.zh: 這家銀行是馬拉松的主要贊助商。

ex.en: A local company sponsored the concert.
ex.zh: 一家本地公司贊助了這場音樂會。

ex.en: The event is sponsored by the city government.
ex.zh: 這場活動由市政府贊助。

ex.en: The team is looking for sponsorship.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍正在找贊助。

ex.en: The event was made possible by the sponsorship of several companies.
ex.zh: 多家公司的贊助讓這場活動得以舉辦。

ex.en: The living room in my new house is very spacious.
ex.zh: 我新家的客廳很寬敞。

ex.en: The hotel rooms are bright and spacious.
ex.zh: 飯店的房間明亮又寬敞。

ex.en: Please check the technical specifications before ordering.
ex.zh: 訂購前請確認技術規格。

ex.en: The product does not meet our specifications.
ex.zh: 這項產品不符合我們的規格。

ex.en: I sprained my finger while playing volleyball.
ex.zh: 我打排球的時候扭傷了手指。

ex.en: Tom sprained his wrist.
ex.zh: 湯姆扭傷了手腕。

ex.en: Tom sprained his ankle.
ex.zh: 湯姆扭傷了腳踝。

ex.en: Could you speak up? I can't hear you.
ex.zh: 可以說大聲一點嗎？我聽不到。

ex.en: Please speak up so everyone can hear.
ex.zh: 請說大聲一點，讓大家都聽得到。

ex.en: If you have any trouble, please speak up.
ex.zh: 有任何問題，請直接說出來。

ex.en: If you disagree, you should speak up.
ex.zh: 如果你不同意，就應該說出來。

ex.en: I don't know how to spell the word.
ex.zh: 我不知道這個單詞怎麼拼寫。

ex.en: Well, I'll tell you how to spell my name.
ex.zh: 好，我告訴你我的名字怎麼拼。

ex.en: That's not how my name is spelled.
ex.zh: 我的名字不是這樣拼的。

ex.en: I get dizzy spells when I stand up.
ex.zh: 我一站起來就覺得頭暈。

ex.en: We had a spell of cold weather last week.
ex.zh: 上週有一波寒流。

ex.en: The witch cast a spell on the prince.
ex.zh: 女巫對王子施了咒語。

ex.en: The music held the audience under its spell.
ex.zh: 音樂讓觀眾聽得如痴如醉。
